column1: # November 2026 / Season 3 Part 2 handoff, captured from the MyMiniFactory library 2026-11-02.
# The library went 131 -> 161 objects; of those, 8 are new Paizo Printables posts: the November
# PDF, a discount-codes post, and the 6 models below. Codes are REAL, read from the vendor
# artwork filenames on the library cards (1000X1000-P01xx_..._S3P2), not inferred. Pack is S3P2,
# confirmed by the object pages' own tag ("Pathfinder paizo S3P2").
# base_mm and size are DELIBERATELY BLANK: the Google sheet has no S3P2 rows yet (season-3 tab is
# still the 6 October models), and unlike earlier releases the card badges state only print scale
# ("28 MM SCALE" / "32 MM SCALE"), not base diameter. Object pages state no base size either.
# Every artwork URL below was verified to load at 1000x1000 through Chrome on 2026-11-02.
# merge-reference does not apply the pack column; set pack by hand or extend it.
# NOTE P0107: the MyMiniFactory object title is singular "Thatchling"; the artwork filename is
# plural "P0107_Thatchlings_S3P2". Name below is the object title - ruling needed (cf. P0101).
